title: How Google helped destroy adoption of RSS feeds (2023)
titleZh: Google 如何帮助破坏 RSS 提要的采用（2023）
author: pudgywalsh
relevanceReason: 命中 2 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: August 14, 2023 Although RSS feeds are alive and still heavily used today, their level of adoption has suffered because of how difficult a handful of popular technology companies have made it to use them. Google, especially, has relied on the open web RSS protocol to gain so much market share and influence, but continues to engage in behavior that exploits the open web at the expense of its users. As a result, Google has single-handedly contributed to the reason many users who once relied on RSS feeds have stopped using them.

Below, we dive deeper into Google's track record of what appears to be an Embrace, Extend, and Extinguish model. The company has continuously built and extended their products around the free and open RSS protocol to gain user trust, only to then remove RSS support once they've locked users in, and ignore any complaints or requests to restore it. Not only is it a blatant disregard for RSS and a huge disappointment to those who use it, it poses one of the biggest threats to the freedom and openness of the internet. Google removes RSS button from Chrome browser Early versions of Chromium (on which the Google Chrome browser is based) once came with RSS integration baked in. The browser had a built-in RSS button that would display in the browser location bar when any website you're on had an RSS feed available. Clicking the button would then take you to the RSS feed for that web page, allowing a user to easily subscribe.
RSS subscribe icon in the toolbar of Google Chromium

Then, the RSS button disappeared without notice, and no reason was given for its removal. Google acquires FeedBurner and limits RSS In 2007, Google acquired FeedBurner, an RSS feed service that allows website owners to monetize their RSS feeds. FeedBurner works by replacing ordinary RSS feeds with private ones that only Google owns. The feeds are modified to include advertisements, affiliate links, and other tracking mechanisms like read counts, click-through rates and subscriber counts. The feeds are then used by FeedBurner users to track their readers and monetize from their behavior.

comments.author: throwaway63467
comments.textRawHtml:
The Internet in the early 2000s felt a little more special as compared to today, when 99.999 % of content is locked in a handful of walled gardens. I mean sure everything we had then is still possible but let’s be honest everything about the web is fine tuned to deliver ads to our eyeballs, browsers, operating systems and even protocols are being designed with ad delivery in mind. Even the privacy friendly browsers just exist to serve ads when I think about it. Kind of sad really, but I guess you could be happy as it’s so big now and there’s so much to do. Just makes you wonder what stuff would thrive if ads didn’t exist. As of now every niche thing that gets successful will be invariably pulled into the ad ecosystem as it’s very hard to say no to money.

RSS wasn’t in the interest of the big platforms as it’s decentralized and there’s no good way to deliver ads through it, simple as that.
comments.textZhHtml:
与今天相比，2000 年代初的互联网感觉更加特别，当时 99.999% 的内容都被锁定在少数有围墙的花园中。我的意思是，我们当时拥有的一切仍然是可能的，但说实话，网络上的一切都经过精心调整，可以将广告投放到我们的眼球、浏览器、操作系统甚至协议的设计中都考虑到了广告投放。当我想到这一点时，即使是隐私友好的浏览器也只是为了提供广告而存在。确实有点悲伤，但我想你应该感到高兴，因为现在它太大了，有很多事情要做。只是让你想知道如果广告不存在的话什么东西会蓬勃发展。到目前为止，每一个取得成功的小众事物都将不可避免地被纳入广告生态系统，因为很难拒绝金钱。

RSS 不符合大平台的利益，因为它是去中心化的，而且没有好的方法通过它来投放广告，就这么简单。

children.author: drnick1
children.textRawHtml:
> everything about the web is fine tuned to deliver ads to our eyeballs, browsers, operating systems and even protocols are being designed with ad delivery in mind.

I use Firefox with uBlock Origin on Linux, and haven't seen an ad in years. It's not like ads weren't a thing 20 years ago. Pop-up windows were particularly bad. Javascript, in particular, has been constantly abused against the user ever since it was created.
children.textZhHtml:
> 网络上的一切都经过精心调整，可以将广告投放到我们的眼球，浏览器、操作系统甚至协议在设计时都考虑到了广告投放。

我在 Linux 上使用带有 uBlock Origin 的 Firefox，已经很多年没有看到广告了。广告在 20 年前并不是什么都没有。弹出窗口尤其糟糕。尤其是 JavaScript，自从它被创建以来就一直被滥用。

children.author: mschild
children.textRawHtml:
> Firefox with uBlock Origin on Linux

Same setup and same experience. I've recently joined another company which only provided chrome with no extensions by default. I know the web is filled with ads but I'm shocked again and again when I get a glimpse into what it's like without an adblocker.
children.textZhHtml:
> Linux 上使用 uBlock Origin 的 Firefox

相同的设置和相同的体验。我最近加入了另一家公司，该公司默认只提供 chrome，没有扩展。我知道网络上充满了广告，但当我看到没有广告拦截器的情况时，我一次又一次地感到震惊。

children.author: cwnyth
children.textRawHtml: There are dozens of us. Maybe one day people will realize how much better Firefox is now and how nicer the web can be with no ads.
children.textZhHtml: 我们有几十个人。也许有一天，人们会意识到 Firefox 现在有多好，没有广告，网络会变得多么美好。

children.author: anonymousiam
children.textRawHtml:
It's not just a better user experience. It also addresses the security issues.

Blocking ads will also prevent malware scripts, unscrupulous information collection, and deceptive virus infection messages. I've got friends who've been infected because they believed the popup that told them their computer had a virus, and they needed to click the link to remove it.
children.textZhHtml:
这不仅仅是更好的用户体验。 它还解决了安全问题。

拦截广告还可以防止恶意软件脚本、不择手段的信息收集和欺骗性病毒感染消息。 我有一些朋友已经被感染，因为他们相信弹出窗口告诉他们他们的计算机有病毒，他们需要点击链接来删除它。

children.author: endless_smash
children.textRawHtml:
Blocking ads is recommended by CISA. It should really be more mainstream.

Some demographics are heavy ad blockers, 90%+.
children.textZhHtml:
CISA 建议屏蔽广告。它确实应该更加主流。

某些人群是严重的广告拦截者，90% 以上。

children.author: MollyRealized
children.textRawHtml: Firefox could be doing a great deal more if it had a more imaginative corporate leadership.
children.textZhHtml: 如果 Firefox 拥有更具想象力的企业领导层，它可以做得更多。

children.author: jerojero
children.textRawHtml:
There's more to ads than banners and unskippable videos.

I bet if you open YouTube, even with Adblock and sponsorblock, you'll see ads. "Tech" channels are nothing but ads because all they do is present products for people to buy.

Even channels that do legos are ad channels.

YouTube itself has become a platform for serving videos that are advertisement at their core. These videos are popular, get good engagement, pay the content creators and come in cheap for brands. This style of "journalism" extends to many other platforms.
children.textZhHtml:
广告不仅仅是横幅和不可跳过的视频。

我敢打赌，如果您打开 YouTube，即使使用了 Adblock 和赞助商屏蔽，您也会看到广告。 “科技”频道只不过是广告，因为它们所做的只是展示产品供人们购买。

即使是制作乐高积木的频道也是广告频道。

YouTube 本身已成为一个提供以广告为核心的视频的平台。这些视频很受欢迎，参与度很高，向内容创作者付费，而且对品牌来说价格便宜。这种“新闻报道”风格延伸到了许多其他平台。

children.author: rustcleaner
children.textRawHtml:
Sponsorblock (FF extension) is neccessary for YouTube, as well as Seal (GUI for yt-dlp) + BravePipe (fork of NewPipe, integrated Sponsorblock) for Android.

Also, adding `Before: YEAR` in search takes you back to a more wholesome time.
children.textZhHtml:
Sponsorblock（FF 扩展）对于 YouTube 是必需的，对于 Android 则需要 Seal（yt-dlp 的 GUI）+ BravePipe（NewPipe 的分支，集成 Sponsorblock）。

此外，在搜索中添加 `Before: YEAR` 可以让您回到更健康的时代。

children.author: yaksha
children.textRawHtml:
Watching Youtube through Brave browser and I can't remember the last time I saw ads (ads by youtube, not by the content creator within the video). Twitch is different story, platform ads certainly play there.

Prior to Brave, ublock origin on Firefox provided a similar ad-free Youtube experience.

I don't consider ad content like the tech channels you mention to be a negative. Informing people about new products is a useful service. The ads that are negative are those that impose themselves over other content or mess with normal internet browsing experience.
children.textZhHtml:
通过 Brave 浏览器观看 Youtube，我不记得上次看到广告是什么时候了（YouTube 的广告，而不是视频中内容创建者的广告）。 Twitch 则不同，平台广告肯定会在那里播放。

在 Brave 之前，Firefox 上的 ublock 提供了类似的无广告 Youtube 体验。

我不认为像您提到的技术频道这样的广告内容是负面的。向人们介绍新产品是一项有用的服务。负面广告是那些强加于其他内容或扰乱正常互联网浏览体验的广告。

children.author: inigyou
children.textRawHtml:
I switched to a Firefox fork, but recently opened Firefox itself and was horrified to see the browser itself shoving ads in my face. Buy our VPN! Sign up to a Mozilla profile! Did you know about the extension store?

Firefox (the product) and Mozilla (the for-profit company) are lost causes. Firefox (the technology) is still there, for now.
children.textZhHtml:
我改用了 Firefox fork，但最近打开了 Firefox 本身，并惊讶地发现浏览器本身将广告推到我面前。购买我们的 VPN！注册 Mozilla 个人资料！您了解扩展商店吗？

Firefox（产品）和 Mozilla（营利性公司）是失败的原因。 Firefox（技术）目前仍然存在。

children.author: rustcleaner
children.textRawHtml: I really like Mullvad Browser, which is Tor Browser -Tor +uBlock Origin, for clean & ephemeral browsing.
children.textZhHtml: 我真的很喜欢 Mulvad 浏览器，它是 Tor 浏览器 -Tor +uBlock Origin，用于干净且短暂的浏览。

children.author: abustamam
children.textRawHtml:
The most annoying thing is whenever I encounter a form with an email input I get an ad right there -- "use our email mask relay! First five are free!"

I can probably turn it off somehow but I feel like it should be opt-in or at least live elsewhere.
children.textZhHtml:
最烦人的事情是，每当我遇到带有电子邮件输入的表单时，我都会看到一个广告 - “使用我们的电子邮件掩码中继！前五个是免费的！”

我可能可以以某种方式将其关闭，但我觉得它应该选择加入或至少位于其他地方。

children.author: inigyou
children.textRawHtml: Just abandon Firefox and switch to another Firefox-based browser.
children.textZhHtml: 放弃 Firefox 并切换到另一个基于 Firefox 的浏览器。

children.author: Gander5739
children.textRawHtml: If you're privacy-minded, I suggest Librewolf.
children.textZhHtml: 如果您注重隐私，我建议 Librewolf。

children.author: pmdr
children.textRawHtml:
> It's not like ads weren't a thing 20 years ago. Pop-up windows were particularly bad.

Google pretty much declared war on those back then, providing reasonable-looking ad formats that could be integrated discreetly on the page (and as far as I remember, they had a limit of how many banners you could show). I really wish we could back to that. Now they serve animated/video ads.
children.textZhHtml:
> 广告在 20 年前并不是什么都没有。弹出窗口尤其糟糕。

当时，Google 几乎向这些窗口宣战，提供了外观合理的广告格式，可以谨慎地集成在页面上（据我所知，他们对可以显示的横幅数量有限制）。我真的希望我们能回到那个。现在他们提供动画/视频广告。

children.author: rustcleaner
children.textRawHtml:
I use Mullvad Browser, which is Tor Browser -Tor +uBlock Origin.

No you don't need Mullvad VPN to use Mullvad Browser.
children.textZhHtml:
我使用 Mulvad 浏览器，即 Tor 浏览器 -Tor +uBlock Origin。

不，您不需要 Mulvad VPN 即可使用 Mulvad 浏览器。

children.textRawHtml:
So we have ad blockers, ad blocker detectors.... 
But apparently no ad blocker blocker. Should I continue?
Block the blockers by blocking the blockage... ouch.
children.textZhHtml:
所以我们有广告拦截器、广告拦截器检测器...... 
但显然没有广告拦截器拦截器。我应该继续吗？
以堵堵堵堵堵堵堵堵堵……哎哟。
